description: Whether international (Air / Ocean) shipping is enabled on the user's Warp account, which door services it offers, and the rules for a destination or origin country (postal code required or not, how locations are given). Pass country to get that country's rules; omit it for the account settings and the list of blocked countries. Requires a signed-in Warp account.

country.description: ISO alpha-2 code of the country to look up

name: international_settings
title: International Settings
